name: standalone_workbook_version_fingerprints
oracle_basis: Workbook differences use the byte hash of the workbook itself. A standalone native workbook and an embedded workbook are equally supported; the enclosing email hash has a separate identity.

original.source:
let db = @@GRAPH@@
let raw = graph_ingest(db,{"schema": "loom.graph.batch.v1", "batch_id": "test", "nodes": [{"id": "s", "type": "source", "origin": "synthetic:workbook", "locator": "Sheet1"}, {"id": "a", "type": "passage", "label": "a", "text": "25", "source_ids": ["s"], "data": {"native_sha256": "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", "sheet": "Sheet1", "cells": {"A1": "25"}}}, {"id": "b", "type": "passage", "label": "b", "text": "20", "source_ids": ["s"], "data": {"native_sha256": "bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb", "sheet": "Sheet1", "cells": {"A1": "20"}}}]}, {"evolution":false})
let compared = graph_case_versions(db,{"left_hash": "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", "right_hash": "bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb", "scope": "same synthetic coordinate"})
expect len(compared["changes"]) == 1
expect compared["changes"][0]["left"] == "25"
expect compared["changes"][0]["right"] == "20"
